current.text: Bobby Portis competes with him for frontcourt minutes behind Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo.
He is not in the projected starting lineup. Early projections had him as a bench player in Miami's main nine.
The expert is unsure he is an everyday rotation player or that he fits next to Giannis.
Miami has the fewest back-to-backs in the league (13) and none in the fantasy playoffs. With a March 28 end it gets only 10 games in weeks 19 to 21 (4-3-3).

durable.text: He is a bad defender and an iffy shooter.
FG% is his weakest category. Both projections have him under 39% on low volume.

note: He is outside the draftable pool for us. Yahoo ranks him 235 and ESPN 253, both value him at 0 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. With 36.6% FG on 17 minutes last year and Portis ahead of him for bench minutes, skip him in the auction. Watch early whether he holds a steady rotation role, or whether an injury to Giannis or Bam opens minutes, before you spend a waiver add.
